```{=html}
<script>
// Quarto also shows its empty-filter message for an initially empty listing.
// Only expose it when the visitor has actually selected a category filter.
function syncCategoryFilter() {
  const category = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1)).get('category');
  document.documentElement.toggleAttribute('data-ggm-category-filter', Boolean(category));
  // Quarto only activates nonempty category hashes; explicitly reset its
  // existing List.js filter when All topics or browser Back clears the hash.
  if (!category) {
    for (const listing of Object.values(window['quarto-listings'] || {})) listing.filter();
  }
  for (const link of document.querySelectorAll('.home-topics a')) {
    const selected = new URL(link.href).hash === `#category=${encodeURIComponent(category || '')}`;
    if (selected) link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
    else link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
  }
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', syncCategoryFilter);
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', syncCategoryFilter);
syncCategoryFilter();
</script>
```
